lines.say: A stranger opened everyone's orders in your food app, without logging in. One service forgot one check.
lines.show: A *stranger* opened [everyone's orders] in your food app, without logging in. One service [forgot one check.]

lines.say: Big apps run separate services: orders, payments, menu. If each one checks logins by itself, sooner or later one gets missed.
lines.show: Big apps run separate *services:* orders, payments, menu. If each one checks logins by itself, sooner or later one gets [missed.]

lines.say: An API gateway puts one front door in front of all of them. Every request, like show my orders, passes through it.
lines.show: An *API gateway* puts *one front door* in front of all of them. Every request, like *show my orders,* passes through it.

lines.say: Think airport security: nobody reaches the gate without passing it.
lines.show: Think *airport security:* nobody reaches the gate without passing it.

lines.say: It checks every request for a valid login. No login? Blocked at the door. The orders service still checks whose orders you can see.
lines.show: It checks every request for a *valid login.* No login? [Blocked at the door.] The orders service still checks *whose orders* you can see.

lines.say: It also sends each request to the right service, and can slow down anyone sending too many.
lines.show: It also *sends* each request to the *right service,* and can *slow down* anyone sending too many.

lines.say: If AI writes your code, follow for the system design it leaves out.
lines.show: If AI writes your code, *follow* for the system design it [leaves out.]
